publication.title: An inverse theorem for the Gowers U^{s+1}[N]-norm
publication.authors: Ben Green, Terence Tao and Tamar Ziegler
publication.locator: Lemma E.8(vi), p.1354, with proof reference p.1356
publication.corrections: The printed E8(vi) contains a domain mismatch for chi-prime, and its B5 citation has a composition codomain typo. The current fixed-integer-map application is checked directly: each iterated difference after precomposition equals the original iterated difference in the image directions. The unchanged global test retains its vertical identity; a lower-degree representation pulls back the same way. No unchecked multidegree or arbitrary limit-coefficient claim is used.
